summary: Read a string s made only of lowercase English letters and an integer k. The length of s is from 1 to 10000, and k is from 1 to 100000. Look for a contiguous segment of s in which every letter that shows up does so at least k times. Among all segments that qualify, write the length of the longest one.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
